verdict.rationale: 1Password documents storing one-time passwords in the user's 1Password account on 1Password.com, and it surfaces them on other devices such as Apple Watch. That implies tokens live in an account rather than only on the phone. However, the pack has no documentation of a recovery path, such as signing in on a new device or recovering after a lost phone. missing for 10: a documented lost-device recovery flow, explicit evidence that OTP seeds restore on a new phone, and independent or hands-on corroboration of recovery.

support.subject: As an everyday user, losing my phone doesn't lose my accounts — a documented recovery path restores my tokens on a new device

citations.quote: Learn how to use 1Password to store and quickly access your one-time passwords when you turn on two-step verification for a website.
Transfer your Logins, Credit Cards, and Secure Notes from other applications into your account on 1Password.com.
Use 1Password on your Apple Watch to quickly look up information: credit card numbers and PINs, one-time passwords
